evidence.observation: O2 starts rising after purge and ramp baseline of ~4-7 ppm: 7.5 ppm
O2 rises steadily through growth: 12.3, 21.2, 24.8, 31.5, 39.1 ppm
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so less argon dilution does not explain the rise
Thermocouple steady at ~750 °C and heater power normal at ~44-46%

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so we can't confirm air ingress through a pressure signature. A leak check (isolate the tube and watch O2 or rate of rise, or leak-test the flange seals) would tell a seal leak apart from other ways air could get in.
